title: OpenCTEM extension namespace, revision 1
description: Informative. The value of extensions["io.openctem"] on a report, metadata, asset or finding. These keys are what OpenCTEM converters and importers carry in properties today; they move to this namespace in a follow-up change. A receiver that does not know the namespace ignores it.

capability.description: On metadata: the OpenCTEM capability the report answers, as id@major (scan.ports@1). A producer claim; the receiver uses the capability of the command it bound the report to.

import_scope.description: On an asset from an importer: whether the asset belongs to the import's target. The receiver decides scope; the importer never drops an outside asset.

candidate_exposure.description: On an asset: an exposure a tool suspects but did not verify. The receiver verifies before it alerts.

candidate_unverified.description: On an asset with candidate_exposure: true while nobody verified it.

bounty_report.description: On a finding from a bug-bounty or disclosure report: intake, ref, researcher (personal data), submitted_at, reported_severity, state, weakness, endpoint_path, parameter, url (https only, never fetched), reward and disclosure.

web_content.description: On a web asset: what a content crawl found (titles, forms, links summary), as the recon converter writes it.
